messages.author: f45657ea067c43ec
messages.subject: getId(el) ignored for Shiny.outputBindings?
parts:
Hi all --- I think this is a bug (given the documentation), but before reporting it as such, I want to make sure I'm not doing anything (too) dumb here...
Basically, I think the getId() function used for OutputBinding objects is being ignored.
The documentation I'm using is here:
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/building-outputs.html

The relevant description for getId(el) is:
"Return the Shiny output ID for the element el, or null if the element doesn't have an ID and should therefore be ignored. The default implementation in Shiny.OutputBinding reads the data-output-id attribute and falls back to the element's id if not present."

It seems like the fall-back is occurring even when this function is overridden.
Below are 3 pieces of code, server.R, ui.R, and my_binding.js (located in the www/ directory).
Based on the description, I believe console.log(data) should show "my_data", but instead it is showing "my_div".

ui.R:
library(shiny)
shinyUI(fluidPage(
    singleton(tags$head(tags$script(src = "my_binding.js"))),
    div(id = "my_div")
))

server.R:
library(shiny)
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
    output$my_data <- renderText("my_data") ## I want this
    output$my_div <- renderText("my_div") ## I get this
})

www/my_binding.js:
var my_output_binding = new Shiny.OutputBinding();
$.extend(my_output_binding, {
    find: function(scope) {
        return $(scope).find("#my_div");
    },
    getId: function(el) {
        // should be bound to server-side output$my_data
return "my_data";
    },
    renderValue: function(el, data) {
console.log(data);
    },
    renderError: function(el, err) {
console.log(err);
    },
});
Shiny.outputBindings.register(my_output_binding);

Per the docs, I believe the server-generated output$my_data should be bound to el, not output$my_div (which is the fallback).

Am I missing something obvious here?

Cheers,

-m
